Forum Cassij, M. P. XXVIII. | Foro Cassi, XI. | Viterbo.

main_text.head: CAPUT XXII. Latium.
main_text.p: ETRVRIAM, quae in Italia Prisca, eaque Occidentaliore & Cis-Apennina, ad Ripam Tiberis dexteram, perlustravi: offert se percurrendum, quod ibidem ad sinistram est, LATIVM, Italiae Regio, quae nullis non Auctoribus celebrata.LATIVM,

Latium dictum putatur ab Saturno, qui Patria profugus in his locis latuisse fertur. Legendus praeter alios Isidorus lib. xiiii. Erymolog. cap. iv. Saturnus, ut antea monui, quasi Deus latens, ab סתר Syriaca voce, quae Latinis Latere. De Laty Etymo Virgilius lib. viii. Æneidos:

l.i: Primus ab aethereo venit Saturnus Olympo,
Arma levis fugiens, & regnis Exsul ademtis:
Is genus indocile, & dispersum Montibus altis
Maluit, his quondam latuisset tutus in oris.

page.notes: The map shows the region of Latium with a cartouche reading "LATIUM sive Campania di ROMA", labelled Campania, Abruzzo, Terra di Lavoro, Campagna di Roma, Tyrrhenian sea and Mare; scale bars at top and bottom read "Septentrio" and "Meridius". Several place names on the map are too small to read and are omitted. Table cells and Greek/Hebrew letters in the text are transcribed as seen; some table entries are uncertain.
